title: Equipment and Furnishings — Rear Cabin — Conversion to the Cabin-Flex Galley and Deep Stowage Arrangement
abstract: Rear cabin conversion that moves the galley complex aft and installs pivoting deep stowage compartments, released against the launch customer's monument layout and material list.

sections.planning_reason: ZEPHYR-24 Evo operators selling into markets with a one-bag carry-on allowance are gate-checking on about one flight in three at typical load factors, and are asking for the two seat rows that become available when the rear galley complex is moved against the rear pressure bulkhead. There is no technical problem with the delivered arrangement; the driver is entirely commercial, and the conversion is normally bought as part of a wider cabin refresh.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin repositions the rear galley complex aft, re-arranges the door 4 area so that two additional seat rows fit into the released floor area, and replaces the overhead stowage with pivoting deep compartments whose load is taken directly into the frame tie.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Strip the rear cabin from the mid galley aft, including the seats, the sidewall panels and the ceiling. Remove the existing overhead stowage and the monument fitting D2520125508153. Install the frame tie brackets and the cushioned clamps AES113070-9A that carry the gas strut anchorage. Fit the deep stowage using the trim kit D2520122039443, the curtain rail D2520125397271 and the revised lining D2520123607135. Re-profile the lower edge of the decor panel at FIN 5138DL to clear the pivoting bin in the open position. Reposition the galley complex and re-connect the water, waste and electrical services. Re-lay the seat tracks and install the additional seat rows. Re-configure the cabin lighting scenes for the new zone boundaries, which requires the solid state lighting standard to be already installed. Do the emergency lighting proof test and the passenger service unit functional test. Do the cabin pressure leak check at the repositioned galley bulkhead. Record the embodiment and issue the revised layout of passenger accommodation.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to ZPH-24N3 and ZPH-24N7 aircraft delivered before the production cut-in of the Cabin-Flex arrangement, in the cabin standard of the launch customer. The material list is written around that customer's monument layout, so an operator with a different delivered standard must ask for an effectivity extension before quoting. The solid state cabin lighting standard must already be embodied, because the scene definitions for the new zone boundaries are only available in that standard. The bulletin does not apply to ZEPHYR-18, ZEPHYR-20 or ZEPHYR-22 aircraft, nor to ZEPHYR-24 classic aircraft.
sections.material_note: Kit K2520-1310-01 covers the stowage, the ceiling and the galley interface for the launch customer's monument layout, and the monument content is fixed. Seats and galley inserts are supplied by the operator against the layout drawing and are not part of the kit. Lead time is thirty weeks.

type_data.compliance_time: At the operator's convenience, normally alongside a cabin refresh.
